reviews.text: We're sorry to hear your experience with us wasn't satisfactory, Juanfrancisco. At Kiwoko, we always strive to offer the best for our customers and their pets. We appreciate you taking the time to leave your review and we'll continue working hard to provide you with a better experience in the future.

Horrible service. This is the second time they've "lost" an order. I'll never buy from here again. It took them two weeks to notify me, and only because I had to find out something. And then they refused to take responsibility. Awful. Very poor service.

I want to express my disappointment with the service I received at Kiwoko.
I had chosen a plush toy that was displayed in an area where the price was listed as €6.99. However, when I got to the checkout, I was charged €14.99. The sales assistant, Andrea, went to check and saw that there were several plush toys in the same spot, but she told me they were misplaced and that, since the product code didn't match the one on the tag, she couldn't honor the advertised price.
What bothered me most wasn't just the price, but the way the situation was handled. She barely let me explain and, without trying to offer any solution or alternative, proceeded directly to refund me.

I'm a regular customer of this store and I usually buy everything for my dogs there, so I expected a more personal touch and better customer service. A mistake in product placement shouldn't be the customer's responsibility, and I would have at least appreciated a more empathetic and helpful approach to handling the issue. I hope they review these types of situations so they don't happen again and that they improve customer service, especially for those of us who have trusted the store for a long time.

I am very disappointed with the service I received at this store.

Google Maps shows the closing time as 10:00 PM. Relying on that information, I traveled for an hour and arrived five minutes before 9:00 PM. The employees at the checkout told me they were already closed and that their hours were until 9:00 PM.

I explained that it wasn't 9:00 PM yet and that I urgently needed dog shampoo, which I knew they had in stock. However, they responded very rudely, repeatedly saying they were already closed and wouldn't sell me anything.

When I asked why Google showed the wrong hours, instead of giving me an explanation or trying to help, they simply kept repeating that they were closed.

I've always been very happy with KIWOCO's online service and customer support, but today, as a customer, I felt "bad," especially because of the feeling that they must have thought I was a "fraud" in the store.

On the 8th, I received an order of "Taste of the Wild" Puppy Formula dog food at the store. Since it was puppy food, and I already had some left over from the previous package before opening the new one, I kept the order at home unopened. My dog ​​hasn't eaten for three days, so I decided to return it. My unpleasant surprise after filling out the return form was that at the Kiwoco store in the Aqua Shopping Center in Valencia, they told me, "The package is open, look, it has a staple." I told the guy I hadn't touched the package. Logically, he didn't believe me, or at least that's the look on his face, along with some under his breath to his colleague, and told me he couldn't process the return. I checked myself and the staple was there, but it was hidden among the packaging design, and I hadn't noticed it. Furthermore, I checked that the package was indeed sealed. I asked the clerk to remove the staple, and we confirmed that it was NOT OPEN, but he insisted he was sorry but couldn't process the return because... The package has air in it... ANGRY AND EMBARRASSED. Of course, I'm leaving feeling ashamed, but I understand that I can't do that. I expect a solution after contacting KIWOKO online. I'm sorry because the store was worth it, but where I've been charged for misuse or attempted fraud, I won't be returning.
